detection_method: Manual code review + GitHub API scope validation

root_cause_analysis.underlying: Token regeneration not included 'security_events' scope; GitHub API requires explicit scope declaration for code-scanning endpoints
root_cause_analysis.why_undetected: Workflow exits gracefully on token validation failure; error is caught early (step 'Validate token availability') with exit code 0 instead of propagating as workflow failure

evidence.finding: Workflow requires CODEX_MASTER_KEY with security_events scope but does not validate scope presence
Fallback exit with early return when token unavailable; no artifact generation occurs
Script assumes token has required scopes; returns HTTP 403 on code-scanning API call

impact_assessment.user_experience: No security snapshot generated; CodeQL, Dependabot, secret-scanning alerts not fetched
impact_assessment.pr_merge_impact: Non-blocking (workflow optional via WEC opt-in); does not prevent PR merge
impact_assessment.data_loss: No data loss; alert data remains on GitHub; only local snapshot generation fails

remediation_options.title: Regenerate CODEX_MASTER_KEY with security_events scope
steps: 1. Navigate to GitHub org Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions → CODEX_MASTER_KEY
2. Regenerate or edit token to include scopes: repo, workflow, gist, security_events
6. Monitor workflow logs for 'All alerts fetched successfully'

remediation_options.title: Create dedicated CODEX_SECURITY_EVENTS_TOKEN
steps: 1. Generate new PAT with scopes: security_events, repo

remediation_options.title: Request emergency GitHub support
steps: 2. Request temporary elevated permissions or emergency scope grant
3. Wait for GitHub support (24-48 hours typical)
4. Use workflow as no-op until resolved

validation_steps.expected: HTTP 200 OK with alert JSON array (not HTTP 403)
Workflow runs successfully and generates artifact

escalation_criteria.condition: PR merge blocked due to missing security snapshot
